snippet.title: The Banishing Act - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
The Banishing Act is a online co-op, horror investigation game. Demons are physically manifesting in the world and the number of haunted is on the rise. Play as a Banisher, find clues to identify Cursed Objects, and perform the Banishing Ritual, sending demons back to the abyss.
WISHLIST NOW ON STEAM:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/5365500/The_Banishing_Act/
Haptic Games Website:
https://playhapticgames.com/
